spec_match.rationale: Concepts map the exact proposal surface (web-speech-api PR #192, OPEN/unmerged as of 2026-07-24; explainer speech-recognition-result-timestamps.md): readonly DOMHighResTimeStamp? audioStartTime/audioEndTime on SpeechRecognitionResult — milliseconds relative to time origin, nullable when the backend supplies no segment timing, with the explainer proposing 2ms rounding or the site-wide timer-resolution policy. Layers kept distinct throughout: result-level (not alternative/word) timestamps, interim vs final results, event.timeStamp as the subtraction operand for latency, audio capture time vs service latency vs wall clock, and the [LegacyNoInterfaceObject] reality that there is no constructor to probe (verified in Chromium main's speech_recognition_result.idl, which currently exposes only length/item/isFinal — the attributes are NOT in trunk yet).

interactive.rationale: Real Web Speech API usage with explicit user-initiated start everywhere: surface probing, live result inspection with mic-permission honesty, latency gauge with threshold control, caption timeline with unpositioned flags. Sample walkthroughs are prominently tagged SAMPLE and never presented as live results. Recognition is stopped on end/stop and, newly this cycle, on pagehide.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index and ledes match delivered concepts and the proposal's exact semantics. Fixed the overstated 'Chrome 153 adds' lede into a labelled proposal (unmerged PR) and replaced 'why it shipped' with 'why timestamps matter'; every enablement note now states the in-flux implementation state honestly: v153 listing dev trial at 153; detail desktop None/'Proposed' (updated 2026-07-16); PR #192 unmerged; attributes absent from Chromium main IDL and no dedicated runtime flag as of 2026-07-24, so even the experimental-features catch-all may expose nothing.

edge_cases.rationale: Honest negatives everywhere: absent-property vs present-but-null distinguished (unsupported vs no-value), headless/no-mic recognition errors reported as availability problems rather than fake results, unpositioned captions never dropped at made-up spots, sample data explicitly non-evidential, and no timestamp is ever inferred from event cadence or simulated transcripts.

references.rationale: All pages cite chromestatus.com/feature/5811907077472256, PR #192 (labelled unmerged), the explainer, and the Web Speech spec; the index also links MDN's SpeechRecognitionResult (verified 200 — it does not cover the timestamp attributes yet, recorded). WPT note: speech-api has 27 test files but no timestamp-specific test as of 2026-07-25 (checked), consistent with the unmerged PR.

conformance.rationale: New immutable root suite has 8 direct timestamp target contracts: audioStartTime exposure, audioEndTime exposure, each value's number-or-null contract, ordered segment bounds, the common time-origin latency calculation, readonly behavior, and result-level receiver placement. Parent removed all eight passing SpeechRecognition/Event/performance prerequisites because they did not test this feature. The renderer now supports an explicit manual/blocked verdict for permission-, backend-, and hardware-mediated contracts. Chrome 150 therefore renders exactly 0 pass / 0 fail / 8 blocked: none was executed, and no microphone is requested automatically.

runtime_evidence.rationale: chrome-devtools-mcp on HeadlessChrome/150 (2026-07-25): all safe controls exercised at 1280×800 and 390×844 with post-interaction geometry — surface probe reports constructors and the absent global honestly, live-inspect reports the no-SpeechRecognition/no-mic path or the real engine answer without fakes, latency threshold control and SAMPLE-tagged walkthrough move the gauge with synthetic lags clearly labelled, timeline renders sample segments with the SAMPLE banner, zero console errors and zero failed requests. No microphone request was auto-issued.

telemetry_health.rationale: Concepts emit showcaseTelemetry.assert events per branch (probe-ran, inspect-no-sr/reported/error, latency-no-sr/null-timestamp/measured/recognition-error, timeline-sample-ran); telemetry POSTs returned 202 during validation.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout, button background+color pairs, focus-visible outlines, no static-card pattern; edits were copy/cleanup level and preserve layout.

accessibility.rationale: role=status/aria-live on verdicts, live outputs, and caption lists; the gauge has an aria-label with current latency + threshold; buttons are native and keyboard-operable; SAMPLE tags are text, not color-only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Matrix pass after two in-place fixes found by this cycle's 390px post-interaction validation: the probe's results table overflowed to 543px (long mono value strings — fixed with overflow-wrap:anywhere + table-layout:fixed, now 306px) and the feature index overflowed to 433px via the unbreakable 23-character title word 'SpeechRecognitionResult' spilling out of its 342px box (text-level overflow invisible to element-rect scans — fixed with page-local h1{overflow-wrap:anywhere}, now 390px). All four pages then re-verified scrollWidth equals viewport at 1280×800 and 390×844 after every control (probe, sample runs, threshold changes, start/stop).

openQuestions.title: Verify timestamp exposure on an implementing build with a timing-capable backend
openQuestions.detail: As of 2026-07-24 the attributes are absent from Chromium main's speech_recognition_result.idl, PR #192 is unmerged, and no dedicated runtime flag exists, so no live timestamp could be observed this cycle (the build also lacks a usable mic/ASR backend in headless). When the dev trial (v153 listing, desktop_first 153) lands in a build, verify with a real user-mediated recognition: audioStartTime/audioEndTime present and number-or-null per segment, precision reduction under the eventual implementation's timer policy, the finite event.timeStamp − audioEndTime latency calculation, and characterize (without assuming) interim-vs-final population. Also track PR #192's merge state and the speech-api WPT directory for new timestamp tests (none as of 2026-07-25).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region announcements for dynamic probe/status results after button activation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic state through live regions tied to the activating control; give status gauges programmatic names and current values.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verified applied: verdicts/live outputs/caption lists use role=status/aria-live; the latency gauge's aria-label carries the current latency and threshold; SAMPLE tags are text labels.

guidanceConsulted.query: microphone capture requests that require explicit user initiation and honest denial states
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Microphone access must be explicitly user-initiated with clear rationale; denial and unavailability are first-class outcomes; stop capture when done.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied strictly: every recognition.start() is behind an explicit button with stated rationale; no auto-request anywhere; stop buttons, onend restoration, and new pagehide cleanup end every session; denial/no-mic/engine errors are reported as availability states, never faked.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: interaction log — zero microphone requests outside explicit clicks; pagehide stops verified

summary: Source-review of the SpeechRecognitionResult-timestamps family against the explainer (DOMHighResTimeStamp? audioStartTime/audioEndTime, ms relative to time origin, nullable, proposed 2ms-or-site-policy precision reduction), PR #192 (OPEN/unmerged as of 2026-07-24), Chromium main's speech_recognition_result.idl ([LegacyNoInterfaceObject]; currently only length/item/isFinal — the attributes are NOT in trunk and no dedicated runtime flag exists), the direct chromestatus detail (updated 2026-07-16: v153 listing dev trial desktop_first 153; detail desktop None, 'Proposed'), MDN (SpeechRecognitionResult 200, no timestamp coverage yet), and WPT (no timestamp tests in speech-api as of 2026-07-25). The family was already structurally honest (LegacyNoInterfaceObject recipe, null-vs-absent distinction, SAMPLE-tagged walkthroughs, no mic auto-request, fabricated values never invented). Hardened: 'Chrome 153 adds' replaced by labelled-proposal framing, 'why it shipped' renamed 'why timestamps matter', all enablement notes now state the in-flux implementation state precisely, and pagehide cleanup added to both recognition sessions. Added the immutable root suite; parent replaced eight adjacent prerequisite passes with eight direct timestamp contracts and added explicit manual/blocked rendering (0 pass / 0 fail / 8 blocked here). Missing-suite denominator 3→2 expected (796/798).
